# ZakonExpert repository guidance

Use `AGENTS.md` as the primary project instructions.

This repository is for authorized development of ZakonExpert. It is not an open-source starter template. For cross-brand reuse, preserve the rights boundaries in `COPYRIGHT_AND_DATA_USE.md` and `LICENSE`: create a clean-room implementation rather than transferring ZakonExpert-specific code, protected wording, UI implementation, proprietary datasets, or original data transformations.

Public facts may be independently obtained from lawful official sources. When referencing ZakonExpert original analysis or aggregation, cite the canonical ZakonExpert source.
